vision.title: Politoed

candidate_models.reason: Name, Italian text, holo artwork and bottom-right number appear consistent.
Number is partially blurred and could be misread.

vision.visual_fingerprint: Italian vintage Pokémon Politoed Stage 2 card with yellow border, blue text area, holographic forest artwork, 110 PV, attacks Crescita Improvvisa, Ranabalzo and Spruzza Energia; bottom-right number appears 12/111.
evidence: The card name “Politoed” is clearly visible at the top.
Italian attack names and Italian rules text are visible.
Holographic Politoed artwork and 110 PV are visible.
Bottom-right collector number appears to read 12/111, but is blurred.
Copyright line visibly begins with © 2000 Nintendo.
missing_information: Set symbol/name is not sufficiently legible.
First Edition stamp cannot be confirmed from this image.
Shadow/shadowless status cannot be reliably determined.
vision.next_photo_request: Provide a sharp, straight-on close-up of the bottom edge and the area below the artwork, plus the full front in even lighting.
vision.verification_summary: The card is confidently identified as an Italian Politoed holo, probably 12/111 from Neo Genesis, but the set and collector number require sharper confirmation.

physical_observations.text: Yellow border with blue lower text panel
Holographic foil artwork background
Three visible attacks with Water and Colorless energy symbols
Stage 2 layout with Politoed evolution portrait at upper left

vision.title: Luka Dončić 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball No. 280
vision.variant: Green prismatic parallel, exact subtype unconfirmed

candidate_models.model: 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball Luka Dončić No. 280 Green Prizm
candidate_models.reason: Visible green prismatic finish; exact parallel subtype not legible.

candidate_models.model: 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball Luka Dončić No. 280 Green Pulsar
candidate_models.reason: Green patterned finish could correspond to a Pulsar-style parallel, but no serial or definitive label is visible.

vision.visual_fingerprint: Two-sided Luka Dončić rookie card, Dallas Mavericks uniform #77. Front has blue/purple Prizm design with bright green prismatic side borders and silver PRIZM logo; reverse reads NO. 280 and shows Real Madrid text, 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball copyright and Panini logo.
evidence: Reverse visibly states NO. 280.
Reverse visibly identifies 2018-19 PANINI - PRIZM BASKETBALL.
Front and reverse both visibly name Luka Doncic and show the Dallas Mavericks.
Front has a clearly visible green prismatic finish, but no parallel name or serial number is readable.
Card is visibly inside a slab; grader and grade are not readable.
missing_information: Exact green parallel subtype
Serial numbering, if applicable
Grading company and numeric grade
vision.next_photo_request: Photograph the slab label and a glare-free close-up of the front parallel pattern and any serial numbering.
vision.verification_summary: The base card identity is directly verified by the visible set, player name, team, and card number. The green parallel is physically visible, but its exact commercial subtype is not proven.

physical_observations.text: Bright green prismatic side borders with blue, purple and silver central design
Reflective geometric Prizm pattern with dotted green foil texture
Two-sided card photographed in a rigid slab
Player image centered with vertical geometric side panels
